header.title: Donut Chart
header.subtitle: Categorical donut chart built on Recharts PieChart. Each slice carries its own color token inline, giving full control over the palette. The Tooltip formats values as percentages by default.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.description: The chart renders a PieChart with a Pie element inside. Each data entry maps to a Cell that carries the per-slice fill color. The Legend is rendered automatically using the name field of each data entry.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Pass a data array with name, value, and color per entry. The Tooltip formats values as percentages automatically.

palette.title: Suggested palette
palette.description: Use system design tokens for all slice colors. This ensures the chart adapts to theme and accent changes automatically — never use hardcoded hex values.

radius.title: Radius variants
radius.description: Control the donut ring via innerRadius and outerRadius. A larger outerRadius with the same innerRadius produces a thicker ring; increasing both together scales the whole chart up.

localized.title: Localized slice names
localized.description: Translate slice names before passing them to the chart. The component renders the name field directly in the Legend — no internal translation occurs.

loading.title: Loading and error states
loading.description: The same loading and error pattern documented on the Area Chart page applies here. Use ChartSkeleton with type="donut" for the correct skeleton shape.

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.description: Known constraints of the current DonutChart API.

props.title: Props
props.description: All props except data are optional.

dataItem.title: Data item
dataItem.description: Each object in the data array describes one slice.

anatomy.responsiveContainer: Responsive wrapper — fills parent width, uses the height prop
anatomy.pieChart: Recharts PieChart root — container for the Pie and overlay components
anatomy.pie: Slice container — receives data array, innerRadius, outerRadius, paddingAngle, dataKey
anatomy.cell: One Cell per data entry — carries the per-slice fill color
anatomy.tooltip: Hover overlay — formats values as percentages; styled via chartTooltipStyle
anatomy.legend: Auto-rendered legend with circle icons — uses data[].name as labels; styled via chartLegendStyle

palette.overflow: For more than 5 slices, repeat the palette or use lighter tints of the same tokens. Never hardcode colors — always reference design system tokens so the chart adapts to theme and accent changes automatically.

limitations.noFormatter: DonutChart does not expose a formatTooltip prop — the Tooltip always renders values as percentages. If custom tooltip formatting is needed, fork the component.
limitations.noAutoPalette: Colors must be passed inline per slice via data[].color. There is no auto-palette mode — explicit is preferred over magic.
limitations.overflowPalette: For more than 5 categories, palette repetition or tinting is the consumer's responsibility.

localized.note: Map data entries to translated names before passing to DonutChart. The component renders name as-is — no translation occurs internally.

props.data: Array of slice descriptors. Each entry must have name, value, and color.
props.height: Chart height in pixels. Defaults to 220.
props.innerRadius: Inner radius of the donut hole in pixels. Defaults to 55.
props.outerRadius: Outer radius of the donut ring in pixels. Defaults to 85.

dataItem.name: Slice label shown in the Legend.
dataItem.value: Numeric value. The Tooltip renders this as a percentage string.
dataItem.color: Fill color. Use CSS custom properties (var(--accent), var(--success), etc.) for theme compatibility.
